subject.title: Orange Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 7

text: Governing Board Member, Orange Unified School District, Trustee Area 7
As President of the Orange Unified School District Board of Education, I keep students at the center of every decision.

This community is my home. My wife, a school principal, and I chose Orange Unified schools for our children because we believe in the opportunities this district provides. Like every parent, we want schools that are safe, academically rigorous, fiscally responsible, and welcoming to every student. I am invested in Orange Unified’s success.

For nearly three decades, I have dedicated my professional life to public education. I have served as a classroom teacher, principal, district administrator, and university professor. These experiences have prepared me to ask difficult questions, evaluate complex decisions, and keep teaching and learning at the center of district governance. I know successful schools require strong leadership, sound financial management, meaningful partnerships with families, and exceptional teachers and staff.

As your elected trustee and Board President, I have worked to strengthen transparency, promote respectful and effective governance, support stable district leadership, and ensure responsible stewardship of taxpayer funds. I have supported investments in safe campuses, high-quality instruction, and the employees who serve our students every day. Drawing on my experience as a principal and district administrator, I helped guide the thoughtful selection of a new superintendent, emphasizing stable leadership, accountability, and long-term planning while keeping students and classrooms at the center of our work.

I am especially proud when I see our students recognized for academic achievement, artistic talent, athletic excellence, service, and perseverance. Those moments remind me that board decisions ultimately affect real children, families, classrooms, and futures.

Public education is one of our community’s most important investments. Strong schools strengthen neighborhoods, support local businesses, protect property values, and prepare tomorrow’s workforce. This responsibility demands experienced leadership grounded in integrity, accountability, collaboration, and service.

Orange Unified has made progress, but important work remains. We must accelerate student achievement, maintain safe and modern campuses, recruit and retain exceptional employees, preserve valuable programs, and exercise prudent fiscal oversight. We must also listen to families, support educators, and ensure every student graduates prepared for college, career, and civic life.

I am honored to serve this community and grateful for the trust you have placed in me. I respectfully ask for your vote for re-election so we can continue moving Orange Unified forward and build a stronger future for every student, family, and school.

text: I believe parents, not politicians, should be the ones stepping up to serve on local school board because they have a vested interest in quality education for all students. That’s why I’ve stepped up to be a voice for parents on the Orange Unified School District.
My family lives here and my children have attended local schools.
Every child deserves the opportunity to learn in a safe, supportive learning environment where they can reach their full potential.

I am committed to responsible spending of your tax dollars by promoting transparency, accountability, and thoughtful budgeting that prioritizes students, teachers, and classroom expenses not bureaucrats.

Only 46% of students are proficient at math. This needs to change. Let’s get back to basics by strengthening reading, writing, math, science, and critical thinking curriculum to help students discover their talents and prepare for college, jobs, and life.

I believe parents and families are vital partners in education. We need a new approach to educating our children that puts students first. By listening, working together, and focusing on what unites us, we can ensure every student can succeed.
I would be honored to have your vote. Visit my website at ElectJackChang.com
